title: The Rights of Children over Their Parents in Tarbiyah and Education
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children over their parents, citing Prophetic hadiths that highlight the importance of the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education. It mentions the story of a man who came to the Prophet ﷺ asking about his son’s right, to which the Prophet ﷺ replied that he should choose a good name for him and refine his adab (manners). It also emphasizes the necessity of justice among children in giving and treatment.

review_defects.why: الآباء means fathers specifically, not parents; the English broadens the scope to include mothers, which is not in the Arabic.
Same issue: آبائهم means their fathers, not their parents.
يشير means indicates or points out, not emphasizes; the English overstates the force of the Arabic.
